name: Lotka-Volterra predator and prey

slots.Xi: prey and predator densities: concentrations in R_+^2
slots.C: unlimited prey growth; predation proportional to encounters
slots.P: bounded write toward a target, release, measurement; sweep of grow
slots.A: grow=1; control grow in (0.5, 2.0); noise D=0.01

provenance: Lotka, Elements of Physical Biology (1925); Volterra, Nature 118, 558 (1926)
loss_law: no stable state: a family of neutral cycles, with no restoring force on the amplitude or the phase (Law 2)

verdict.stores: no stable state: a family of neutral cycles, with no restoring force on the amplitude or the phase (Law 2)
verdict.constructs: a single stable state: no write point
verdict.holds: no stable state: a family of neutral cycles, with no restoring force on the amplitude or the phase (Law 2)
